title: User Configuration
description: A person who assumes project roles. Roles are granted per project and environment; the login must exist in Snowflake unless create is true.

login.description: Snowflake login name (exact, as CURRENT_USER() returns it)

email.description: Email, only used when creating the user

schema_prefix.description: Prefix of the personal schemas (<PREFIX>_SRC, ...) and SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA in .env; defaults to DBT_<login before the @, non-alphanumerics as _, upper case>

not.description: DBT is the placeholder an empty SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA falls back to; it must never have schemas

create.description: Create the user in Snowflake with a one-time password; false when the login already exists (SSO)

roles.description: Project roles this user may assume

environments.description: Environment keys, or '*' for every environment of the project
